posts.title: How to run .NET tools without the SDK
posts.description: I have renamed ndnx to ndx. .NET 10 shipped dnx (dotnet tool exec): one-shot nuget tools, npx-style. You don’t install them. You just run dnx stop and it downloads into the nuget cache and starts. NOTE: I’m using stop as the sample Native AOT tool.
